body: Opus2 lesson (2026-11-21 ~05:25Z, my own slip, caught by Sol-a7bb #2543). The remote-run test ref bullet allows pushing ONLY a merge-ready input: every required review complete with no outstanding Medium or higher, AND a fresh focused compile and tests covering its changes and new tests passed on that EXACT input. I pushed process_limits' test ref (a465a7a5) and started PL-FULL-1 with the pair clean but no focused pass on aa1a9c04 (its 26-case focused leg was still queued). I had done the same on the combo86 batch (2445755d). Before every test-ref push (single or batch), check and cite: (1) a clean pair; (2) a focused run that PASSED on the exact commit or tree being frozen, covering the changed modules and new tests. For a batch, the contributions' own focused runs are on other inputs, so place a focused run on the combined commit first. If none exists, place the focused run (DL560 when Central is constrained) and push the ref only after it passes.
